subject: GCP co-sell listing readiness & joint pipeline review request
messages:
From: Amit Shah <amit.shah@gcp-partners.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: gcp-marketplace-support@gcp-partners.com
Date: Fri, 02 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Co-sell listing readiness + joint pipeline review for BlueSpring

Hi Karthik,

Thanks again for the conversation earlier this week. BlueSpring Health is progressing toward production trials and asked whether Redwood can be listed and enabled for co-sell on GCP. Before we kick off the official marketplace intake, GCP partner ops asked for a quick joint pipeline review between your partner manager, your sales lead, and BlueSpring’s buying team so we can map opportunities to GTM motions.

I attached a short checklist (gcp_co_sell_checklist.xlsx) that lists common listing pre-reqs (billing account mapping, security evidence, GCP listing manifest). Can we schedule a 45-minute sync next week to:
- Walk through the checklist and assign owners
- Identify top 3 joint opportunities and who will lead the capture
- Agree on a PoC timeline and co-sell motion (referral versus lead-assisted)

Proposed times: Tue 4/6 10:00–10:45 PT or Wed 4/7 8:30–9:15 PT. If those don’t work, suggest alternatives.

Attaching the checklist and a preliminary listing manifest.

Thanks,
Amit
Partner Manager, GCP Partnerships
GCP Partner Ecosystem
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Amit Shah <amit.shah@gcp-partners.com>, Sana Patel <sana.patel@bluespringhealth.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 02 Apr 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Co-sell listing readiness + joint pipeline review for BlueSpring

Thanks Amit — this looks good. I'm copying Marcus (sales) and Vanessa (partner ops) to get operational coverage.

Both proposed times work for me; prefer Tue 4/6 at 10:00 PT. Key things we want to confirm on the call:
- Which billing model will BlueSpring expect (marketplace billing vs direct invoicing)
- Security artifacts they need up front (SOC2, data residency statement)
- Priority accounts/opps and a quick qualification for co-sell fit

Vanessa, Marcus — can you review the checklist and flag any Redwood-specific gaps before the call? I’ll pull together a short slides deck to align on ask/CTA.

Action: tentatively book Tue 4/6 10:00 PT, will send invite after confirming with Marcus & Vanessa.

Best,
Karthik
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Amit Shah <amit.shah@gcp-partners.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 02 Apr 2027 12:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Co-sell listing readiness + joint pipeline review for BlueSpring

Also adding a few notes from the sales perspective:
- Pre-req: we need BlueSpring’s procurement cadence and timeline (Sana, can you send your procurement lead’s rough ETA and whether a purchase order is expected?)
- For co-sell eligibility, we should qualify the top opps by ARR potential and deployment model (hosted vs private). If the PoC expects private deployment, co-sell incentives may differ.
- I reviewed the checklist: two likely gaps for us are (1) billing mapping (we need a GCP marketplace billing owner) and (2) a signed MSA or at least an LOI for commitments. I’ll surface a recommended deal structure on the call.

Vanessa: can your team prepare the short listing manifest (one-pager) and confirm which of these artifacts we can provide immediately vs which require partner IT work? Tessa — can you be on the call to capture action items and follow-ups?

Thanks — Marcus
Sr. Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Confirmed for Tue 4/6 10:00 PT — I’ll send the calendar invite with dial-in details shortly. For prep, attaching the one-page listing manifest we typically use (listing_manifest.pdf) and a short intake checklist view.

Pre-call requests (please action before Tue):
- Sana (BlueSpring): please share procurement ETA and the primary technical contact for integration (email + phone).
- Amit: can you confirm whether GCP expects marketplace billing (billing account) or will the customer purchase directly? That determines the immediacy of our billing mapping task.
- Marcus: please draft the top-3 opps (name, estimated ARR, PoC scope) in a quick bullet list and drop it in the Drive link.

I’ll also add a row in the checklist with owners and target dates so we can run that in the follow-ups. Tessa will take notes and create HubSpot tasks (HS-78421).

Cheers,
Vanessa Ortiz
Partner Operations, Redwood Inference
